title: Fix check_example_verification() comparison bug + stale test fixture
description: Added 2026-09-17 (TC-05 follow-up, deep pass, plan-mode approved). skill-governance.yml has failed 100% of its September runs due to a latent bug in scripts/ci/checks/check_platform_capabilities.py::check_example_verification() (added 2026-09-06, commit acd165e07e): its reverse-completeness loop compares the full real registry.PLATFORM_CONTRACT (scripts/pipeline/lib/example_verification/registry.py, never fixture-mocked) against the narrower checkable_platforms parameter instead of the tested YAML's own full declared platform set. A pre-existing negative-control test, test_same_fixture_passes_once_the_value_is_corrected (scripts/ci/tests/test_check_platform_capabilities.py, dated 2026-08-29, predates the buggy function by 8 days), uses a single-platform (typescript-only) fixture that trips this bug every run -- NOT real data drift; platform_capabilities.yaml and registry.PLATFORM_CONTRACT are fully in sync for all 7 platforms, verified directly. FIX: change the tail loop to iterate over caps["platforms"].keys() (the tested YAML's own declared set), not checkable_platforms. Also fix/update the stale test fixture (and audit sibling tests in the same file for the same narrow-fixture blind spot) to remain valid under the corrected logic -- either expand its fixture to all 7 real platforms or scope its assertion the way test_typescript_class_kinds_disagreeing_with_real_code_fails already correctly does (filter findings to the platform under test, not a blanket findings == []). Route through /workflow-harden (S-115), whose scope already covers scripts/ci/**. VALIDATION: pytest scripts/ci/tests/test_check_platform_capabilities.py -v locally (safe, not a workflow dispatch) plus the full 1594-test governance suite for regressions. REGRESSION CONTROL: add a test pinning the corrected behavior against a partial fixture (more than one, fewer than all real platforms) -- the exact shape that silently broke this time.

title: Evaluator-version-bump 3-way pre-commit wiring + docs fix
description: Added 2026-09-17 (TC-05 follow-up, deep pass, plan-mode approved). content-governance-checks.yml fails 49% of the time on scripts/ci/checks/check_evaluator_version_bump.py ("BLOCKED: evaluator(s) changed without a version bump"), a different evaluator file each time -- a recurring authoring-discipline gap, not a broken check. ROOT CAUSE (verified, NOT the git_plumb_commit.py hook-skip hypothesis, which was investigated and refuted): the check was never wired into pre-commit anywhere -- absent from scripts/pre-commit-audit.sh (the real pre-commit hook), absent from git_plumb_commit.py's manual pre-flight re-check list (which DOES re-implement stale_file_regression for exactly this reason -- evaluator-version-bump was simply never added), and absent from the local CI-simulation mirror script (which DOES include the sibling check_evaluator_freeze.py). Since this repo has no PR gate and no branch protection, a CI-only check can only ever fire after the commit already landed on main. Compounding: AGENTS.md section 9a links to docs/workflows/evaluator-changes.md, deleted 2026-05-30; its replacement docs/development/evaluator-changes.md dropped the version-bump guidance entirely. FIX: (1) add check_evaluator_version_bump.py as a new step in scripts/pre-commit-audit.sh, adapted to diff staged/working changes against HEAD (not origin/main -- a real semantic difference from the CI invocation, needs deliberate handling not copy-paste); (2) add it to git_plumb_commit.py's manual pre-flight re-check list, mirroring the existing stale_file_regression re-implementation; (3) add it to the local CI-simulation mirror script alongside check_evaluator_freeze.py (confirm that script's exact path first); (4) restore the version-bump guidance into docs/development/evaluator-changes.md. NOTE: AGENTS.md itself is human-maintainer-authored only per its own header -- the section 9a link fix is a human action item, NOT agent-executable; flag to the user separately, do not edit AGENTS.md. VALIDATION: stage a synthetic evaluator edit without a version bump and attempt a commit through both /commit (S-76) and git_plumb_commit.py -- confirm both now block it; bump the version and confirm both allow it. REGRESSION CONTROL: add pre-commit-hook test coverage mirroring test_check_stale_file_regression.py's pattern for its sibling check.
